item.title: Tennessee lawmakers pass bill expanding death penalty eligibility in child rape cases
item.description: From Local 3 News: UPDATE: The Tennessee General Assembly has approved new legislation aimed at strengthening penalties for child rape cases, sending the measure to the governor’s desk.House Bill 1454, sponsored by Rep. Greg Martin (R-Hixson), expands the aggravating circumstances under which prosecutors can pursue the death penalty for those convicted of raping a child.
